# `aitbc energy floor`

Compute the energy floor for given rental terms (EVM or native rail).

## Usage

```bash
aitbc energy floor [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--resource-id` | text | — | yes | Canonical resource ID |
| `--gpu-count` | integer | — | yes | Number of GPUs |
| `--duration-seconds` | integer | — | yes | Rental duration in seconds |
| `--settlement-unit-scale` | integer | `1000000000000000000` | no | Settlement unit scale |
| `--json-output` | flag | `false` | no | Output raw JSON |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc energy floor --resource-id <resource_id> --gpu-count <gpu_count> --duration-seconds <duration_seconds>
```
